instruction: How to create a server.conf from scratch for typical VPN
output:
cat > /etc/openvpn/server.conf <<EOF
port 1194
proto udp
dev tun
ca ca.crt
cert server.crt
key server.key
dh dh.pem
tls-crypt tc.key
server 10.8.0.0 255.255.255.0
ifconfig-pool-persist ipp.txt
push "dhcp-option DNS 8.8.8.8"
keepalive 10 120
cipher AES-256-CBC
auth SHA256
user nobody
group nogroup
persist-key
persist-tun
status openvpn-status.log
verb 3
explicit-exit-notify 1
EOF

instruction: How to create the client.ovpn template
output:
cat > /etc/openvpn/client.template <<EOF
client
dev tun
proto udp
remote SERVER_IP 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
ca ca.crt
cert CLIENT.crt
key CLIENT.key
auth SHA256
cipher AES-256-CBC
verb 3
EOF

instruction: How to generate client ovpn with embedded certs
output:
cd /etc/openvpn && cat <(echo -e 'client
dev tun
proto udp
remote 192.168.1.10 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
key-direction 1
<auth-user-pass>
<ca>') ca.crt <(echo -e '</ca>
<cert>') client1.crt <(echo -e '</cert>
<key>') client1.key <(echo -e '</key>
<tls-crypt>') tc.key <(echo -e '</tls-crypt>') > client1.ovpn

instruction: How to generate a client config with inline credentials
output: cd /etc/openvpn && cat client.template | sed 's/SERVER_IP/192.168.1.10/' | sed 's/CLIENT/client1/' > client1.ovpn && echo '<ca>' >> client1.ovpn && cat ca.crt >> client1.ovpn && echo '</ca>' >> client1.ovpn
